children: Teucrium Commodity Trust announced it will resume accepting redemption orders for the 7RCC Spot Bitcoin and Carbon Credit Futures ETF after outstanding shares rose above the 50,000‑share minimum.
The Fund’s outstanding shares increased above the 50,000‑share minimum due to new creation orders, prompting resumption of redemptions.
Redemptions had been rejected since Aug. 31, 2026, to avoid falling below the five‑basket (50,000 shares) threshold.
Sponsor may again reject redemptions if shares return to the 50,000 minimum or for other prospectus‑listed reasons.
Resumption of redemption acceptance does not guarantee narrower bid‑ask spreads or improved secondary market liquidity.
